author: Laura E. Richards
title: In My Nursery
edition: Project Gutenberg 39741 transcription from an undated Little, Brown and Company reprint; its print date is unidentified. Every selected poem was collated in full against the Roberts Brothers, Boston, 1890 primary witness (https://archive.org/details/inmynursery00richiala; dated title page at scan leaf 4). All selected words agree after whitespace normalization; Gutenberg punctuation, apostrophe spacing, pronunciation accents and plain-text typography are retained. Paragraph wrapping is reflowed; stanza and verse line breaks are retained; page numbers and illustration captions are excluded. On 2026-11-18 the twelve further poems read by Grade 2 calendar readings (blocks 48–71, 77–84, 98–101, 108–112, 142–145, 147–156, 158–161, 170–174, 178–180, 182–191, 298–311 and 313–324) were collated in full against the same 1890 witness, word by word against its OCR text (https://archive.org/download/inmynursery00richiala/inmynursery00richiala_djvu.txt) with every difference decided on its page images: all their words agree, and one printed mark is restored, the section numeral "III" of "The Eve of the Glorious Fourth" to the witness's "III." (page 76), which changed one reading. On 2026-11-18 nine more poems read by Grade 2 calendar readings (blocks 347–355, 365–369, 376–383, 415–421, 439–447, 479–494 and 498–502) were collated in full against the same 1890 witness in the same way, punctuation included: four readings changed to the witness's, a comma in "The Forty Little Ducklings" ("they were, very very ill", page 91) and in "Mother Rosebush" "hero" to "here" twice and "All!" to "Ah!" (pages 115–116); no earlier reading cited those blocks. On 2026-11-18 sixteen more poems read by Grade 2 calendar readings (blocks 504–511, 533–536, 538–543, 587–598, 600–603, 605–610, 620–628, 630–635, 637–642, 650–652, 673–684, 727–736, 758–769, 876–879, 946–951 and 991–999) were collated in full against the same 1890 witness in the same way, punctuation included: five readings changed to the witness's, in "The Three Little Chickens" "surprise," to "surprise;" and "Sing on now" to "Sing us now" (pages 119–120), in "Master Jack's Views" "pranks." to "pranks," (page 139), in "Song of the Mother Whose Children Are Fond of Drawing" "shade;" to "shade," (page 141) and in "What a Very Rude Little Bird Said to Johnny This Morning" "lawn!" to "lawn," (page 152); no earlier reading cited those blocks.

rights.basis: The identified Roberts Brothers witness explicitly dates its title page 1890. Every supplied poem was collated against that original English text, published before 1931 and public domain in the United States as of 2026. Project Gutenberg 39741 also explicitly states public domain in the USA; the undated reprint is not assigned an invented printing date.

acquisition.method: Downloaded Project Gutenberg HTML pg39741-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror of the Gutenberg cache and converted with a scratch HTML parser: h1–h6 become headings, p elements paragraphs, stanza divs and br-broken lines stanzas (one line per printed line, indentation dropped), HTML entities decoded, inline emphasis rendered as plain text, prose whitespace folded to single spaces. Omitted throughout: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, page-number anchors, illustrations and their captions, the title page and copyright leaf, the contents, and the publisher's "Books by Laura E. Richards" at the end. Kept: the verse dedication to Julia Ward Howe and every poem and prose piece with its printed notes in brackets, and the one footnote (to "Hoddy-Doddy", quoting Edward Lear) as its own paragraph "[Footnote 1: …]" where the transcription places it, its marker [1] kept in the verse. Emendation to the 1890 witness (2026-11-18), as a single-occurrence replacement: "III" to "III." (The Eve of the Glorious Fourth, section III). Further emendations to the 1890 witness (2026-11-18), each a single-occurrence replacement: "they were very very ill." to "they were, very very ill." (The Forty Little Ducklings); "Salutes you hero" to "Salutes you here", "All! Maréchal" to "Ah! Maréchal" and "And hero and there" to "And here and there" (Mother Rosebush). Further emendations to the 1890 witness (2026-11-18), each a single-occurrence replacement: "great surprise," to "great surprise;" and "Sing on now" to "Sing us now" (The Three Little Chickens); "wonderful pranks." to "wonderful pranks," (Master Jack's Views); "grateful shade;" to "grateful shade," (Song of the Mother Whose Children Are Fond of Drawing); "out on the lawn!" to "out on the lawn," in the third stanza (What a Very Rude Little Bird Said to Johnny This Morning).
